project_type: Tauri desktop app: Rust core crates (hybrid-orchestrator/crates/*) + React/TypeScript webview (hybrid-orchestrator/frontend/)
build_system: Cargo workspace under hybrid-orchestrator/ for Rust; npm + Vite for the frontend. Per-crate formatting only (never cargo fmt --all).
test_framework: Rust: cargo test per crate (unit tests inline + tests/*.rs integration, e.g. orchestrator-core/tests/pipeline_e2e.rs). Frontend: vitest + @testing-library/react with jsdom; Tauri IPC mocked via vi.mock('@tauri-apps/api/core') invoke and vi.mock('@tauri-apps/api/event') listen.
build_command: Frontend: (cd hybrid-orchestrator/frontend && npm run build) which runs `tsc && vite build`. Rust: (cd hybrid-orchestrator && cargo build). NOTE: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY sandbox cannot install crates/npm packages (crates.io + npm return 403), so build/test likely cannot run here; validate offline with static checks + fmt --check where the toolchain is present.
test_command: Frontend: (cd hybrid-orchestrator/frontend && npm test) -> vitest run. Rust per crate: (cd hybrid-orchestrator && cargo test -p orchestrator-core -p tauri-app -p providers).
verification_instructions: Frontend: npm run build (tsc strict + vite), npm run lint (eslint), npm test (vitest run), npx prettier --check . Rust: cargo clippy -D warnings and cargo test per changed crate; cargo fmt --check per crate. These require network to install deps and may not run in the sandbox; if so, rely on static review + prettier/fmt --check where possible and mark the rest as CI/user-build verification.
setup_instructions: Frontend deps: (cd hybrid-orchestrator/frontend && npm ci). Rust: cargo fetch under hybrid-orchestrator/. Both require network; unavailable under INTEGRATIONS_ONLY.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY: no external network. crates.io and npm return 403, so cargo build/clippy/test and npm install/build/test likely cannot run in-sandbox. No live Ollama at http://127.0.0.1:11434, so Issue 2 (silent no-response) CANNOT be reproduced live here; it must be traced in code, fixed at the most likely cause, and made visible so the user's own build reveals anything remaining. Do NOT touch the embedded-engine feature-flagging/release bundle or the embedded folder-scan rework. Do NOT regress Ollama enumeration or provider diagnostics.
contribution_requirements: Per-crate cargo fmt (never --all). clippy -D warnings clean (no unused imports; if a variant is newly emitted, drop its #[allow(dead_code)]; no needless_lifetimes). TS: eslint no-unused-vars, tsc strict. Every vitest that mounts <App/> or a chat component that calls invoke MUST mock ALL commands it invokes (send_message, get_messages, list_available_models {models,errors}, provider_diagnostics {configuredCount,totalModelCount,providerCountWithModels,providers}, list_conversations, list_personas, list_mcp_servers, list_cloud_providers, list_local_runtimes, list_embedded_models, embedded_model_status) with well-formed shapes; assert after state changes with await findBy*/waitFor. If a CoreEvent shape changes, update orchestrator-core serde (camelCase) + frontend CoreEvent TS type + every event-handling test. New/changed Tauri command -> generate_handler! in lib.rs + IPC wrapper in commands.ts + TS type. Do NOT push/tag/PR.
key_patterns: Backend emits streaming CoreEvents (MessageStarted/MessageDelta/MessageComplete/MessageError, camelCase serde tagged union) over a single event channel; frontend app.tsx opens ONE onCoreEvent subscription and fans out to each store's applyCoreEvent. run_turn (pipeline.rs) already emits MessageError + persists an Error-status message on ANY failure. The prior 'clean-empty picker' bug was fixed in list_available_models_inner by building the registry PER-ROW resiliently (build_from_config in a loop, collecting build_errors) instead of the fail-fast providers::build_registry (which short-circuits on the FIRST build failure via build_all's `?`). The providers store load() captures IPC rejections into loadState/lastError instead of swallowing them.
relevant_files: hybrid-orchestrator/frontend/src/state/conversations.ts (Issue 2: sendMessage swallows IPC rejection; messageError drops the message text; no user echo / send state)
hybrid-orchestrator/crates/tauri-app/src/commands.rs (send_message_inner: fail-fast build_registry -> switch to resilient per-row build mirroring list_available_models_inner)
